The image shows roughly 1,700 pairs tied within $10^{-9}$ of the maximum, close to the $453\cdot4-10=1802$ effective degrees of freedom, followed by a clear slack gap, so this is a nearly isostatic, strictly jammed local optimum whose active contact topology will be restored by ordinary LP or gradient steps. Recent attempts at larger surgery timed out at 200 s, meaning successful work must combine genuine topology changes with strict internal time budgets and preservation of the best feasible iterate.
